title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap - Fortress of Winds
description:
A very "ruinsy" sounding theme from LOZ: Minish Cap. This theme works for castles/fortresses. It fits a ghost house (although it's not haunted), and it sort of fits an airship.

UPDATE: Tacked on $F4 $02 to make it sound better.
